text.offer: You wish to join our fight for freedom? I cannot trust you, for you may be a spy for my enemies. Prove your value by bringing me a scimitar.
text.progress: Before Jonas D'Accor will let you join his ranks, he must be convinced you are not a spy. Bring him a scimitar, and you will gain his trust.
text.complete: Excellent work! This will equip the troops I field in battle. Consider yourself one of the freedom fighters for the land.
